mapper.select: SELECT gc.id, u.id AS user_id, gc.google_email, COALESCE(gc.gmail_connections_status, 'DISCONNECTED') AS status, gc.oauth_client_registration_id, gc.oauth_principal_name, gc.connected_at, gc.updated_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN gmail_connections gc ON gc.user_id = u.id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.users_status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} AND login_id = #{loginId} AND users_status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT client_registration_id, principal_name, access_token_type, access_token_value, access_token_issued_at, access_token_expires_at, access_token_scopes, refresh_token_value, refresh_token_issued_at, created_at FROM oauth2_authorized_client WHERE client_registration_id = 'gmail' AND principal_name = #{principalName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oauth2_authorized_client ( client_registration_id, principal_name, access_token_type, access_token_value, access_token_issued_at, access_token_expires_at, access_token_scopes, refresh_token_value, refresh_token_issued_at ) VALUES ( #{clientRegistrationId}, #{principalName}, #{accessTokenType}, #{accessTokenValue}, #{accessTokenIssuedAt}, #{accessTokenExpiresAt}, #{accessTokenScopes}, #{refreshTokenValue}, #{refreshTokenIssuedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (client_registration_id, principal_name) DO UPDATE SET access_token_type = EXCLUDED.access_token_type, access_token_value = EXCLUDED.access_token_value, access_token_issued_at = EXCLUDED.access_token_issued_at, access_token_expires_at = EXCLUDED.access_token_expires_at, access_token_scopes = EXCLUDED.access_token_scopes, refresh_token_value = EXCLUDED.refresh_token_value, refresh_token_issued_at = EXCLUDED.refresh_token_issued_at

INSERT INTO gmail_connections ( user_id, google_email, gmail_connections_status, oauth_client_registration_id, oauth_principal_name ) VALUES (#{userId}, #{googleEmail}, 'CONNECTED', 'gmail', #{principalName}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET google_email = EXCLUDED.google_email, gmail_connections_status = EXCLUDED.gmail_connections_status, oauth_client_registration_id = EXCLUDED.oauth_client_registration_id, oauth_principal_name = EXCLUDED.oauth_principal_name, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE gmail_connections SET gmail_connections_status = 'REAUTH_REQUIRED', updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND oauth_client_registration_id = 'gmail' AND oauth_principal_name = #{principalName} AND gmail_connections_status = 'CONNECTED'
UPDATE gmail_connections SET gmail_connections_status = 'DISCONNECTED', oauth_client_registration_id = NULL, oauth_principal_name = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
